traits.leaf_arrangement.note: DELTA, Leguminosae page (read 2026-10-16): leaves mostly alternate, opposite or whorled in a few groups; APweb Fabales page has Quillaja spiral. Fabaceae (~19,600 of ~20,400 order species) sets the weighting.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: DELTA, Leguminosae page (read 2026-10-16): phyllotaxis spiral or two-ranked; APweb Fabales page: Quillajaceae leaves spiral, some legume subfamilies two-ranked. 'usually' spiral is my weighting from the largest groups.

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Fabales page, Fabaceae characterisation (read 2026-10-16): leaves odd-pinnate with stipules; Quillajaceae simple and toothed. Weighted by Fabaceae's size; Polygalaceae (~1,000 spp.) simple.

traits.division_pattern.note: APweb, Fabales page (read 2026-10-16): legume leaves pinnate (odd-pinnate) as a rule; palmate/trifoliolate in a minority of papilionoids (e.g. lupins, clovers).

traits.rosette.note: DELTA, Leguminosae page (read 2026-10-16): trees, shrubs, herbs, climbers with leafy stems; basal rosettes not a family feature (only a few stemless Astragalus-type herbs). Inferred, no source states rosettes outright.

traits.life_span.note: DELTA, Leguminosae page (read 2026-10-16): woody plants and herbs, the herbs annual, biennial or perennial. 'usually' perennial is my weighting: most species are trees, shrubs or perennial herbs.

traits.inflorescence.note: APweb, Fabales page, Fabaceae (read 2026-10-16): inflorescence racemose; DELTA Leguminosae: panicles, racemes, spikes or heads, a few solitary (heads mostly mimosoids).

traits.flowering_position.note: DELTA, Leguminosae page (read 2026-10-16): inflorescences terminal, axillary or leaf-opposed. Weighting 'lateral usually' is my inference from papilionoid and mimosoid axillary racemes and heads.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb, Fabales page, Fabaceae (read 2026-10-16): flowers monosymmetric for the family, polysymmetric in parts of Cercidoideae, Detarioideae and the mimosoid clade; Polygalaceae zygomorphic. Weighted by species.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Fabales page (read 2026-10-16): hypanthium in some legume subfamilies and in Quillajaceae, not general. Matches what Fabaceae and Polygalaceae state.

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb, Fabales page (read 2026-10-16): single stalked carpel in Fabaceae, free carpels in Quillaja; no inferior ovaries in the order.

traits.carpels.note: APweb, Fabales page (read 2026-10-16): Fabaceae one carpel; Quillajaceae five; Polygalaceae two.

traits.fruit_type.note: APweb, Fabales page (read 2026-10-16): legume opening along both sutures in Fabaceae; follicles in Quillaja, capsules mostly in Polygalaceae.

traits.sexual_system.note: DELTA, Leguminosae page (read 2026-10-16): mostly hermaphrodite, some andro- or polygamomonoecious (mimosoids). Polygala bisexual (my knowledge, not read on a page).
